text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
CAPITAL
- The government amended the law on foreign investments.
ADEVARUL
- Under new rules set by the Competition Council aquisition and mergers of companies with turnouts exceeding 10 billion lei must be reported to the Council.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- The SNCFR railway authority plans to sell old rolling stock in a tender.
- EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- The Romanian bulk carrier Rovinari caught fire while at anchor in the Black Sea port of Constanta.
- High interest rates prevent farmers from taking credits.
- Imported petroleum products are cheaper than those produced locally, the paper says.
- Amendments brought to the law on foreign investments will put Romanian and foreign investors on equal footing, Finance Minister Ulm Spineanu is quotyed as saying.
General:
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- Romania's air force commander General Ion Stan has died in a plane crash.
- European leaders support Romania's NATO entry bid.
ADEVARUL
- President Emil Constantinescu criticised parliamentarians for their reluctance to lift the parliamentary imunity of PMs accused of alleged illegalities.
ROMANIA LIBERA
- German Chancellor Helmut Kohl supports Romania's bid to join NATO in the first wave, the paper says.
-- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
